title: Capacity credit bands and SLA fallback experiment for Dedicated
creator: Aisha Verma
description: Objective: Design and validate a capacity-packaging variant that uses time-windowed credit bands (capacity credits + burst leasing) and an explicit SLA fallback policy for Dedicated customers. Hypothesis: A banded credit model (base reserved units + burst credits with graded preemption/grace windows + autoscale headroom) will increase enterprise conversion by enabling lower base commit pricing while preserving predictable availability for high-tier customers. Key deliverables: 1) Pricing matrix with 3 credit bands (Core, Flex, Premium) describing reserved units, burst pool, grace/preemption windows, and overage uplift; 2) Contract language for a 'Capacity Continuity' addendum that codifies fallback to compatible model variants, regional failover, and prioritized queueing; 3) Implementation checklist for billing/telemetry and Console UX flags; 4) Security & contract questionnaire (SQ) responses and required controls (KMS, audit retention, patch cadence) for each band. Success metrics: - Conversion rate from trial to committed Dedicated >= +12% vs baseline over 90 days for pilot cohort - Average committed monthly spend per customer uplift >= $15k for Premium band - P99 tail latency and node-preemption incidents related to burst events remain within SLA targets for Premium customers (p99 latency < target, incidents/day < 0.05) - Unit cost delta for Redwood per-token does not exceed modeled thresholds for Core band (<= +10%) Measurement plan: Simulate our fleet using last 6 months of multi-tenant traces to model burst utilization and cost; run a 3-customer pilot (one per band) for 60 days. Contract/SQ work: Prepare detailed SQ answers for enterprise legal reviews and procure legal signoff on the Capacity Continuity addendum. Engineering tasks: autoscale policy knobs, prioritized routing, quota enforcement for burst pools, billing metering for credit debits. Console tasks: pricing selector, estimated monthly spend calculator, SLA badge and fallback indicators. Stakeholders: Product (Aisha), Sales Lead (Maya Chen), Legal (Ravi Patel), Security (Priya Rao), Finance (Diego Alvarez), Runtime Eng (Luca Moretti), Console UX (Hannah Lee).
acceptance_criteria: Pricing matrix published and approved by Finance and Sales
